name: Official register asserts a relation the act's text never states (implicit repeal by expiry and replacement)
name_fr: Relation officielle sans phrase dans le texte (abrogation implicite par expiration et remplacement)

origin.campaign: September 2026 — human audit of the EUR-Lex truth (audit-200)

seen.corpus: EUR-Lex / Cellar, lot A — the official relations graph frozen 2026-09-09; text of the acts on EUR-Lex
seen.observer: Sébastien Gracia (human auditor, audit-200, fact f-477411), no model
seen.excerpt: Cellar dit que le règlement (CE) n° 718/1999 abroge le règlement (CE) n° 2819/95. Le texte de 718/1999 ne cite jamais 2819/95. Il dit : « le règlement (CEE) no 1101/89 a instauré un régime d'assainissement structurel … qu'il prend fin le 28 avril 1999 » ; et 2819/95 est le règlement qui modifiait 1101/89. Le nouveau règlement remplace un régime qui expire ; il n'abroge rien en toutes lettres. Le registre déduit, le texte ne dit pas. Un graphe construit depuis les textes ne trouvera jamais cette arête ; un graphe construit depuis le registre la porte sans phrase.
seen.excerpt_en: Cellar says Regulation (EC) No 718/1999 repeals Regulation (EC) No 2819/95. The text of 718/1999 never names 2819/95. It says: "Regulation (EEC) No 1101/89 introduced a structural improvement scheme … which expires on 28 April 1999"; 2819/95 is the regulation that amended 1101/89. The new regulation replaces a scheme that expires; it repeals nothing in so many words. The register infers, the text does not state. A graph built from the texts will never find this edge; a graph built from the register carries it without a sentence.

probes.note: One document, three checks, all live: the register asserts, the text search finds nothing, the text states an expiry instead. How many such edges the register holds is what the audit of the truth will count.

prevention.note: no sentence to find: the relation exists only as a registry inference; code that reads the text cannot see it, code that reads the register cannot tell it from a stated repeal

repair.note: nothing to delete: the edge is legally sound and textually absent; classified by judgment, not measured

history.event: found by a human auditor of the EUR-Lex truth (fact f-477411 of audit-200): the register says 'repeals', the text says 'expires on 28 April 1999'; probe written and run live the same day
